name: BULL_ST_ASLEEP
meaning: sleep anim 4; waits for the wake conditions. SetState(0) on an awake bull turns into state 2 with anim 5

name: BULL_ST_CHARGE
meaning: straight charge at chargeTargetPos (800/1100 u/s, 2-s timeout, loop sfx 0xfd)

name: BULL_ST_IDLE
meaning: awake; charges when the target or Gossamer enters the movement boxes; catches sheep in SHEEPBOX

name: BULL_ST_SKID
meaning: anim 0xd; next state 1 when it wraps (the anim-0xc slide branch is dead)

name: BULL_ST_HIT
meaning: reached the target: Wolf MSG_KILL arg 4, or sheep toss (anim 0xf); 10 s then state 2

name: BULL_ST_STUNNED
meaning: after MSG_KILL (anim 8); exits through msg 0x38 (sets state 8) and Reset

name: BULL_ST_SCARF_PAW
meaning: anim 6 for 2 s then state 7; only for a carried RedScarf (class 51, unregistered), so unreachable

name: BULL_ST_SCARF_CHARGE
meaning: charge at the scarf; unreachable in the shipped game

name: BULL_ST_RETURN_HOME
meaning: walks to homePos, then state 0; also after msg 0x38 or leaving the movement boxes

name: BULL_ST_ESCAPE
meaning: falls through NORETURNBOX without collision, then ScnObject_RemoveFromWorld; Reset ignores it (permanent)
